outfit.name: 翡翠立裁风衣裙与白皮草披肩
outfit.prose: A body-skimming dark forest green midi dress with tailored seamlines, high split collar, and a wide-lapel winter white coat draped dramatically over her shoulders. Layered tiered pearl choker necklaces contrast against the dark fabric, with sheer black stockings and a structured leather leg strap peeking beneath the slit hem.
